name: publish_case_items
description: Add items to the case trainer's bank (lani.cases/v0, companion/README.md "Case trainer"): items: 1-30 {id (kebab-case, not the bank's), kind which|place, level A1|A2|B1, sl (one sentence, ≤14 words), en, de, it, word (its token index: the sentence split at spaces, from 0), lemma, pos noun|adj|pron|name, gender (an adjective's noun's), case imenovalnik|rodilnik|dajalnik|tozilnik|mestnik|orodnik, number sg|du|pl, why (a rule key of get_cases' bank rules: brez, iz, nikalnica, k, v-na-kam, v-na-kje, z-s, pod-za-kje, object, subject …), trigger (the deciding word's token, or null with role subject|object), also (more tokens right to tap: the verb beside v/na), ambiguous (other slots of the same form: "nom.pl"), note {en,de,it} (how the sentence decides an ambiguous form); a place item also question kje-kam|v-na|pri-k|od-kod, gap [from,to], options (2-3), answer, cue, scene}. Each is checked as the bank is: the form against the dictionary, the trigger against its rule, the pages and scenes. Publishing again under an id replaces your item. Returns the problems instead of publishing if any.
